one_line: The Kadamba-era brahmadeya land-grant network personified as a scholarly yet state-building patron of tax-free villages.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean but sturdy build, with the bearing of both a learned Brahmin and an emerging ruler
appearance.face: oval face with medium-brown Deccan complexion, sharp nose, well-defined jawline, a small vertical sandalwood tilak on the forehead; default expression is calm, observant and slightly introspective, softening into a faint, thoughtful smile when looking at scrolls or fields
appearance.hair: thick black hair gathered into a high Brahmin-style topknot (shikha) slightly to the back of the crown, neatly bound with a narrow dark-red cloth band; short, tidy side hair above the ears; no beard, only a fine, well-kept moustache; wears a simple, narrow gold forehead band (patta) above the tilak
appearance.costume: He wears a long, ankle-length off-white cotton uttariya and dhoti combination in early historic Deccan Brahmin style: the lower garment is a plain off-white dhoti wrapped tightly and knotted at the waist, falling in clean pleats to the ankles, while an off-white upper cloth (uttariya) with a muted mustard-yellow border is draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the torso in a modest, fully covering wrap; over this he has a soft, light-brown, knee-length cotton angavastra-style outer wrap folded neatly over his left arm when not in use; a narrow woven waist-belt in dull red and brown holds a small palm-leaf scroll case; he is barefoot but wears simple leather foot-straps when shown outdoors; jewellery is minimal and plausible for an early Kadamba elite—slim gold earrings (simple hoops), a single thin gold neck chain with a small leaf-shaped pendant, and a plain copper bracelet on his right wrist; the textiles are matte cotton or light handwoven cloth, mostly plain with subtle borders rather than elaborate patterns, reflecting an austere yet respectable Brahmin-agricultural milieu tied to agrahara institutions.
appearance.signature: A bundled sheaf of palm-leaf land-grant charters tied with a dark-brown cord and encased in a slim wooden and leather scroll-box, carried in his left hand or slung at his hip, with one prominent copper plate grant (small rectangular bronze plate with ring) often shown partially visible when he gestures to it while indicating a stylised village landscape.

ref_desc: A mid-30s Deccan Brahmin patron with medium-brown skin, high black topknot, off-white dhoti and uttariya with mustard-yellow border, light-brown wrap, minimal gold jewellery, and a bundled palm-leaf and copper-plate land-grant case in off-white, mustard, light-brown, dark-red and bronze tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a historically grounded early Kadamba-era Deccan Brahmin patron in his mid-30s, with a lean but sturdy build, medium-brown complexion, an oval face with sharp nose and defined jawline, a small vertical sandalwood tilak, and a calm, thoughtful expression; give him thick black hair in a high Brahmin-style topknot slightly behind the crown, bound with a narrow dark-red cloth band, short tidy side hair, a fine moustache and no beard, and a slim gold forehead band above the tilak; dress him in an ankle-length off-white dhoti wrapped tightly with clean pleats and fully covering the legs, an off-white upper cloth (uttariya) with a muted mustard-yellow border draped from the left shoulder across and around the torso so the chest and torso are modestly covered, and a light-brown knee-length cotton outer wrap folded neatly over his left arm, with a narrow woven waist-belt in dull red and brown, simple gold hoop earrings, a thin gold neck chain with a small leaf-shaped pendant, and a plain copper bracelet; show him barefoot or in simple leather foot-straps appropriate to the early historic Deccan, with textiles looking like matte cotton or handwoven cloth; in his left hand or at his hip, depict a bundled sheaf of palm-leaf land-grant charters tied with dark-brown cord inside a slim wooden and leather scroll-box, with one small rectangular bronze copper-plate grant partly visible as he gestures toward an implied village landscape; keep the dominant colours off-white, mustard yellow, light brown, dark red and bronze, and present him front, side and back in one image to emphasise consistent hair, costume and the land-grant bundle as his signature prop.
